paragraphs.text: The Fabric of All Being is an ancient artifact from the Edge that predates the Fomori-Eldrazi war . It is in possession of the Drix .

The Fabric of All Being is kept on a Drix beam world hidden from other species. It contains the fates of all things, and was instrumental in unlocking the knowledge of weftwalking for the Drix, some of which they shared with Pinnacle to guide that alliance in the development of eternity columns and drives .
The artifact is used by the Drix to identify and assassinate critical potential Eldrazi beings to slow or prevent their return.
